title: What 8x42 on your binoculars means
storyboard: Film: close-ups of hands turning focus wheel and dioptre on 8x42 binoculars at a trailhead
caption:
8x42 isn't a model number

It also tells you the type: about 42 mm is full-size, 32 mm compact, 25 mm pocket. Not sponsored.
